nodes.name: Search Cratio by mobile
nodes.notes: Credential: Query Auth, name "apikey", value = your Cratio API key. Cratio takes the key as a query parameter, so a Query Auth credential keeps it in n8n and out of this file. Searched by MOBILE, not email: searchcondition uses @ as its field separator and the test email contains one.
